items.label: SPY5 + SPYL (S&P 500 duplication)
items.detail: SPY5 ($223,473.60, live get_account_positions) and SPYL ($118,497.60) both track the S&P 500 and together total $341,971.20 = 69.80% of NAV ($489,923.80, live get_account_summary). Fresh 1-year daily-return correlation between the two (n=212, get_price_history closes through 2026-08-31; SPYL's history only starts 2025-10-27) is +0.9894 -- effectively one position split across two tickers.
items.recommendation: Trim SPYL (the smaller, more redundant leg, 6,240 shares) by roughly a third (~2,080 shares, ~$39,500 at $18.99) and redeploy into DBC (Invesco DB Commodity Index): this run's fresh correlation test found DBC the single best diversifier against the SPY5+SPYL blend (-0.2391) of seven candidates tested (SHY -0.0206, IEF +0.1168, TLT +0.1480, AGG +0.1758, EFA +0.4798, VWO +0.5538). Note DBC is itself a volatile, inflation-linked asset, not a low-vol ballast -- size it as a genuine diversifier, not a safety cushion (use the SHY ballast below for that).

items.detail: get_pa_allocation (ESTIMATED -- returned realtime:false, dated 2026-08-28, three days stale) shows 0% of NAV in bonds -- 81.01% ETFs, 18.81% direct equities, 0.18% cash by that snapshot's own accounting; live get_account_positions confirms no bond ETF is currently held. CME FedWatch-derived odds of a 25bp September 16 hike stand at 66% as of Aug 31, 2026 (source: Forbes, 'CME FedWatch Provides A 66% Chance Fed Will Hike Rates In September,' Aug 31, 2026), up from roughly 56% shortly after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish Aug 28 Jackson Hole remarks and from ~35% before them.
items.recommendation: Establish a Treasury ballast sized at roughly 5% of NAV (~$24,500) in SHY (1-3Y): SHY showed the lowest correlation to the account's CRWV/GEV AI-infrastructure pair (-0.0573 of 7 candidates tested this run) and stayed in an extremely tight 81.26-83.20 range all year (~2.3% total swing), confirming genuine duration-ballast behavior -- the most defensible shock absorber if the Fed surprises hawkish on Sept 16.

Size at roughly 15-20% of the cluster's value (~$9,000-$12,000).

items.recommendation: Trim CRWV specifically (the pair's higher-dollar leg, 58.6% of the pair's value) toward GEV's weight, or lean on the SHY ballast above: a dollar-weighted CRWV/GEV blend (58.6%/41.4%) shows a -0.0573 correlation to SHY, the lowest of seven candidates tested this run (IEF +0.0041, TLT +0.0136, DBC -0.0025, AGG +0.0603, EFA +0.4246, VWO +0.4958).
